content: Avishkar (NyayaSathi / Aura AI) is a Flutter mobile application featuring Bill Analysis (LLM & regex parsing for hidden charges), OCR Scanner with ML Kit, Live Translation Service, and QR/Barcode scanning.

Services: 1) BillAnalysisOrchestrator coordinates BillParserService, ChargeAnalyzer, and LLMBillService to detect hidden charges and price anomalies. 2) OCRService uses Google ML Kit for text recognition. 3) TranslationService handles multilingual translation. 4) ScanHistoryService manages persistent SQLite scan history.
